Universal Abuse & Profanity Protection

Real-time detection and blocking of abusive language, harassment, and masked profanity across the entire web, regardless of language or script.

Monitors comments, discussion threads, and text blocks on any website in real time.

Enforcement Action

Choose how abusive comments and text are presented on the page.

Detection Features

Catches masked patterns like "ma*ar", "m@d@r", "f*ck", "ch**iya", "b.c", spacing, repeated letters, and zero-width characters.

Analyzes comments with mmBERT across English, Hindi, Hinglish, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Russian, and Indic languages.
